question: How do current deep-learning architectures combine images and text, in captioning, text-to-image generation, images helping language models, text helping vision models, and joint models?
contributions: Survey of five sub-areas: Image2Text (3.1), Text2Image (3.2), Images supporting Language Models (3.3), Text supporting Vision Models (3.4), Models for both modalities (3.5).

limits: Most results are the original papers' own numbers, reported not rerun; the chapter's only own measurement is an informal rclip laptop test.
Tables are images; several prose statements disagree with them (see results notes and problems).
Flamingo ablation scores (68.4, 46.9, 56.5, 59.7) have no metric or table in the chapter.
GPU type for CLIP ViT-L/14 is not stated.
Generative models are compared on FID and human preference of their own papers with different protocols (zero-shot vs trained, reranking, temperature), so ranks are not like for like.
Dated: covers up to about 2022 models (DALL-E 2, Imagen, Parti, Flamingo).
practices: Evaluate generated images with several measures (IS, FID, precision/recall, CLIP score, human evaluation) since there is no consensus on one (Sec 3.2.1).
Use classifier-free guidance, eps_hat = eps(empty) + s*(eps(y) - eps(empty)), to trade diversity for fidelity in diffusion decoders (GLIDE/unCLIP sections).
Prompt CLIP zero-shot with a template such as 'A photo of a {label}.' and ensemble many prompts (Sec 3.4, p.154).
Test few-shot models on held-out benchmarks separate from the dev set used to choose design (Flamingo, p.176).
Prefer a frozen pretrained LM with gated cross-attention to preserve language ability when adding vision (Flamingo, Sec 3.5.3).

terms.definition: share of tokens in a corpus that are visually grounded, i.e. appear more than 100 times in MS COCO (Tan and Bansal, 2020)
contextual token-image matching that assigns each token an image (voken) to supervise a language model
DALL-E 2 design: a prior maps a CLIP text embedding to a CLIP image embedding, a diffusion decoder generates the image
module in Flamingo turning variable image/video features into a fixed number of visual tokens
cross-attention layers inserted into a frozen LM, gated by tanh(alpha) with alpha initialised at 0
